digest.greeting: Good morning, Jean. Monday, November 2 is anchored by Denver's Amazon Connect revalidation, go/no-go, and 4:00 PM AST review, with reduced Colombia coverage and Mar, Jhara, and Nicolas unavailable. Eight unchecked tasks carry forward, including three urgent items. First, require clean call-routing and Direct-to-Agent evidence before cutover; then clear the Supabase security warning and lock MHE coverage. Use the morning focus window to finish the aging LeadUp follow-up and verify the team's Toggl close, and complete Jorge's portfolio update before today's deadline. Repository completion state was last updated October 27, so recent dashboard check-offs may not yet be reflected.

items.label: Lock the Amazon Connect Denver launch decision
items.detail: Friday's troubleshooting may have affected call routing, and the latest transcript showed regular-call transcriptions arriving 20 to 40 minutes late while voicemail prompts also regressed. Treat the 11:30 AM AST revalidation and noon Denver validation as the gate: verify Direct-to-Agent and routing first, confirm the analytics workaround and monitoring owner, record the go/no-go, and keep Hilary's RingCentral rollback path ready.

items.label: Remediate the critical Supabase RLS warning
items.detail: The critical security action remains unchecked in repository state. Verify the affected public table, enable the intended protections, and confirm the Security Advisor alert clears during the morning focus window.

items.label: Set MHE rollout ownership after the holiday
items.detail: Mar remains out through 6:00 PM AST and Colombia-based coverage is reduced today. Confirm interim escalation coverage, then assign owners and dates for the remaining intake, disclosure, task-set, provider-state, and rollout work.

items.label: Close the Quality intake-governance loop
items.detail: Sara confirmed the TRACE fields project will move to CoE and Eugenia will coordinate a broader discussion on how CI can support Quality. Record the agreed intake path, ownership, and treatment of the Denial/RFE categorization work so the governance reset is operational.

items.label: Complete the LeadUp growth-mindset follow-up survey
items.detail: This remains open for a sixth daily digest. Finish the short follow-up in the 9:00 to 11:30 AM focus window before Module 4 activity displaces it again.

items.label: Confirm the Cross-Firm Lead Intake project name
items.detail: Confirm that CLIP is the Cross-Firm Lead Intake project and keep the same name and February 1, 2027 discovery target in the portfolio record.

items.label: Verify the team's Toggl month-end close
items.detail: The monthly update deadline passed Friday and Sara is expected to run the report today. Check for visible gaps and follow up only with the teammates whose entries are still incomplete.

items.label: Decide Eugenia's CoE OKRs dashboard access
items.detail: Approve the appropriate permission level or route the request to the dashboard owner so Eugenia is not blocked from the Q4 CoE view.

items.label: 8:00-9:00 AM - Approve timecards and set the week
items.detail: Clear timekeeping, scan overnight Denver changes, and set the launch, security, and coverage decisions before the first technical checkpoint.

items.label: 9:00-11:30 AM - Main focus window
items.detail: Use the largest open block to clear the Supabase action, finish the aging LeadUp follow-up, verify Toggl gaps, and prepare the Denver decision checklist.

items.label: 11:30 AM-1:00 PM - Denver revalidation and final go/no-go
items.detail: Teams announced technical revalidation at 11:30 AM AST and final Denver validation at noon, overlapping the protected calendar block. Verify call routing and Direct-to-Agent first, then document the cutover or hold decision, monitoring owner, and rollback trigger.

items.label: 2:00-3:30 PM - BD portfolio review and Maria 1:1
items.detail: Carry forward only the unresolved owner, deadline, or portfolio-risk decisions. Use the 30-minute gap between meetings to record outcomes before switching context.

items.label: 4:00 PM - Amazon Connect end-of-day go-live review
items.detail: Review deployment results, outstanding issues, monitoring coverage, and next steps. Treat delayed analytics, voicemail behavior, outbound caller ID, and rollback readiness as explicit acceptance criteria rather than background detail.

items.label: Complete Jorge's portfolio-document update today
items.detail: Jorge added BCP, MHE, and other projects to the document and asked for the information Jean has available by Monday. Add the grounded status, owner, and risk context, especially that BCP/Incident Response is on hold pending a new sponsor.

items.label: Give Sara feedback on the Product-to-EPMO handoff templates
items.detail: Sara asked the EPMO managers to review the I-824 discovery report and solution brief. Flag what the handoff still needs for ownership, requirements, readiness, dependencies, and execution planning so she can respond to Evan today or Tuesday.

items.label: Holiday and absences reduce Monday coverage
items.detail: Colombia observes All Saints' Day today. Mar's out-of-office block runs through 6:00 PM AST, Jhara is out through today, and Nicolas said he will be out Monday. Route urgent launch, MHE, and portfolio decisions to the available named owners.

items.label: 10:30-11:30 AM - Jhara 1:1 and slide preparation
items.detail: Use the 1:1 to close portfolio roadblocks and next owners, then move directly into the short EPMO slide-prep block.

items.label: 11:30 AM - CM CoE and Amazon Connect standups conflict
items.detail: Choose coverage in advance. The CM CoE touchpoint and Amazon Connect daily standup overlap exactly, so name a delegate or define the decision and readout required from the meeting Jean does not attend.

items.label: Noon-4:00 PM - Focus, leadership, and 1:1 sequence
items.detail: Protected work time at noon leads into the 2:00 PM EPMO TL catch-up and 3:30 PM Nicolas 1:1. Carry one concise risk-and-owner narrative across the afternoon.
